concerns.text: Task T002 fails to implement the mandatory hyperparameter grid search over `n_estimators` and `max_depth` required by Constitution Principle VII.
Task T007 only implements SHAP values, silently dropping the requirement for permutation importance mandated by Constitution Principle VII.
Task T002 implements a binary failure check for overlap (< 500) but fails to measure and record the 'data merge success rate' required by SC-001.
Task T002 relaxes the technical approach defined in plan.md; it omits SparCC and SPIEC-EASI compositional correlation analysis, implementing only Spearman.
